(5) Intended Use:
The intended use of the 318 Plus Nasal CPAP System is to provide Continuous
Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) between 3 and 18 cm H2O to spontaneously
breathing adult patients for the treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in a homecare
environment. This is the same intended use as for the C314 Nasal CPAP System.
